name: Populjarnost', beskonechnaja eda i ideal'naja devushka (ne reklama)
original_name: Популярность, бесконечная еда и идеальная девушка (не реклама)
source:
Attention internet users! A website that grants wishes is now open to you. No need for hidden islands, ancient relics, or deals with dubious djinn. It’s much easier than that. Perhaps this is your one real chance — the kind that appears only once in a lifetime.
Do you want to meet the girl of your dreams? To wake up famous without risky stunts? Or to break free from your routine?
Enter. Click. Wish. And don’t be surprised if the world shifts a little.
